## Weekly Update - 2026-08-30

hey <@&1424461167883194418> — 99 merges this week. The garden acquired several useful new rooms.

### 🧰 Agents & MCP
- Hosted MCP registry and Gen proxy are live, plus hosted `FFmpeg` and `Exa Search` MCP servers.
- Agents can be registered through the API, composed together, and MCP now supports audio transcription and multi-input FFmpeg jobs.
- CLI grew `polli earnings` and `polli harness`, including a DeepSeek Harness profile.

### 🗺️ Models, but navigable
- Model search filters, tool-calling capability, context windows, and video-duration limits now live in the catalog.
- Canonical model slugs are announced; open any model straight in Play with `/play?model=<id>`.
- New arrivals: `GLM-5.3 Flash`, `Wan 3.0`, and `Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash` video.

### 🎬 Inputs & community
- Seedance now accepts reference media inputs. Video frame limits are enforced from the registry, so fewer interpretive dances from the API.
- Community model price/visibility changes get a 12-hour delay; self-owned community model calls are free.
- Model owners can inspect earnings in the SDK, CLI, and linked activity cards. Quest leaderboard accuracy also got a real upgrade.

### 🌱 The unglamorous good stuff
- Atomic API-key budget reservation, overdrawn-wallet blocking, clearer UTC activity timestamps, and more faithful billing/price reporting.
